reason: 论文提出了一种新的代理评估方法AV-AIVAT，可以在不完全信息游戏中实现更便宜的代理评估。

analysis.zh: 该研究提出了一种新的代理评估方法AV-AIVAT，通过认证的随时停止机制，在不完全信息游戏中实现了更便宜的代理评估。
analysis.en: This research introduces a new agent evaluation method, AV-AIVAT, which uses certified anytime-valid stopping to achieve cheaper agent evaluation in imperfect-information games.

zh.what: 本文介绍了一种新的代理评估方法AV-AIVAT，可以在不完全信息游戏中实现更便宜的代理评估。

zh.biz: 这种方法可以显著降低代理评估的成本，适用于需要频繁评估的游戏开发和研究领域。

name: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
description: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-contex
reason: 论文提出了MIST基准，通过选择性信任来解决语言模型在外部信号误导下的问题。

analysis.zh: 该研究提出了一种新的方法，让语言模型能够在不同条件下选择性地信任外部信息。这有助于提高模型的鲁棒性和准确性。
analysis.en: This research introduces a new method for language models to selectively trust external information under different conditions, which can improve the robustness and accuracy of the model.

zh.what: 本文介绍了一种新的选择性信任机制，称为MIST，旨在帮助语言模型更好地处理外部信号。
zh.why: 现有的解决方案往往过于保守，导致模型忽视所有上下文。而MIST则通过人类标注的数据集，提供了一个更加灵活和实用的方法。
zh.biz: 这种方法可以广泛应用于各种需要处理外部信息的语言模型场景，具有较高的商业潜力。

en.what: The paper introduces a new selective trust mechanism called MIST, aimed at helping language models better handle external signals.
en.why: Existing solutions tend to be overly conservative, leading the model to ignore all context. MIST, however, provides a more flexible and practical approach through a human-annotated dataset.
en.biz: This method can be widely applied in various scenarios where language models need to process external information, offering high commercial potential.
